api.feature_function: merge_features(own, cav_id, partner_reports=None, *, now_s, partner_ids=(), cfg=None) -> np.ndarray
api.additive_hook: with_merge_features(observation, own, cav_id, partner_reports=None, *, now_s, partner_ids=(), cfg=None) -> Mapping
api.units: physical SI, queue length and approaching counts in vehicles
api.default_off: feature function returns zeros without reading inputs; additive hook returns the exact original mapping
api.enabled: additive hook shallow-copies the mapping and adds only the merge_features block; existing observation values retain object identity and bytes

observable_contract.own_packet: current timestamp must equal now_s; source must be cav_id
observable_contract.partner_packets: only explicitly selected partner_ids; source ID must match report key; exact now_s - 1.0 timestamp; source within 100 m of ego; nearest four valid publishers, ties by ID
observable_contract.sensor_rows: direct observations only, within 100 m of their publisher and in that packet's explicitly observed_lanes; packet source is also observable
observable_contract.timestamps: apply to all rows in the atomic packet; fractional seconds supported without integer truncation; no position extrapolation or cross-step cache
observable_contract.queue_length: visible unique vehicles with speed < 5 m/s and s_m <= 75.44; local lower bound, includes ego when applicable
observable_contract.approaching: visible unique vehicles with s_m < 0, including stopped vehicles; arithmetic mean of observed speeds
observable_contract.rear_gap: nearest visible rear vehicle in each lane relative to ego longitudinal position; max(0, ego_s - rear_s - measured_ego_length)
observable_contract.deduplication: own sensing wins, then nearest publisher, then publisher ID; reduction and rear-vehicle ties are deterministic by vehicle ID
observable_contract.missingness: explicit lane coverage, absent approaching-speed/rear data, own packet and partner packet flags; invalid atomic packets treated as missing
threshold_sources: src/wms/control/contract.py: SENSOR_RANGE_M, CONTROL_DT_S, MERGE_S0_M, MERGE_S1_M, N_LANES
observable_contract.global_state: not an accepted input; no global report iteration, truth features or RSU aggregate inputs

integration.recipe: Construct timestamped SensorReport packets from actual local sensing, explicitly declare sensed lanes, retain each partner's original t-1 packet, supply selected V2V partner IDs, and stack returned per-CAV blocks for the cooperation layer.
integration.base_actor: Keep the frozen MAPPO input unchanged; consume the separate merge_features key only in the cooperation layer.
integration.coverage_requirement: Only declare lanes that the actual local sensor observes; same-lane-only sensors declare just their own lane. Vehicle length must be observable geometry.
